adjudication.rationale: In `spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb`, the example “creates a topic view when a topic_id is found” sets `TopicView.expects(:new).with(123, nil, {best: 5})` but does not specify a return value, so Mocha will return `nil` by default. The controller assigns `@topic_view = TopicView.new(...)` and does not otherwise use it in the action; meanwhile Rails controller specs do not render templates unless `render_views` is enabled. As a result, the newly added `app/views/embed/best.html.erb` (which dereferences `@topic_view.posts` and `@topic_view.topic.url`) is not exercised by this spec, so a broken embed template could slip through with passing tests. This is a test coverage/quality issue grounded in the diff, not a runtime defect in production behavior.
